name: Patellar Tendinopathy (Jumper's Knee)
description: Pain and microtrauma at the inferior pole of the patella, aggravated by deep knee flexion under heavy or rapid loads.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: High blocks eliminate deep knee catch shock and reduce patellofemoral joint reaction force.

safeSubstitutions.replacementName: Power Clean from Hang + Push Press
safeSubstitutions.rationale: Hang power variations remove deep receiving position while preserving explosive hip drive.
Box squat shifts torque to posterior chain and eliminates forward knee translation.
RDL targets posterior chain without anterior knee shear.

rehabCues: Perform Spanish squat isometric holds (5x45s) prior to loading.
Focus on slow 3-4s eccentric squats to promote patellar tendon remodeling.

name: Quadriceps Tendinopathy
description: Pain at the superior border of the patella where the quadriceps tendon attaches.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Reduces quad tendon tensile strain by enforcing vertical tibia.
Shifts load to glutes and hamstrings.

rehabCues: Warm up with light leg extensions and reverse Nordic curls within pain-free range.

name: Meniscal Irritation / Strain
description: Joint line tenderness and catching sensation in deep flexion with rotational loading.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Muscle snatch avoids rapid knee flexion and rotational torque on the meniscus.

rehabCues: Keep feet firmly planted to prevent tibial torsion under load.

name: Subacromial Impingement / Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy
description: Compression of the rotator cuff tendons beneath the acromion during overhead abduction and internal rotation.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Maintains triple extension power without putting the shoulder in extreme overhead lockout.
Scapular plane pressing relieves subacromial space pressure.
Maintains leg drive and upper back stimulus without overhead compression.

rehabCues: Perform face pulls, band external rotations, and prone Y-raises.
Work on thoracic spine extension over a foam roller before lifting.

name: Acromioclavicular (AC) Joint Sprain / Irritation
description: Pain at the top of the shoulder aggravated by cross-body adduction and heavy barbell dips or presses.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Neutral grip allows independent scapular tracking.

rehabCues: Avoid heavy dips and behind-the-neck presses until AC joint palpation is pain-free.

name: Lumbar Strain / Discogenic Low Back Pain
description: Ache or sharp tightness in the lower back with flexion and spinal axial compression.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Pulling from above knee significantly reduces lumbar moment arm.

safeSubstitutions.replacementName: Belt Squat / Front Foot Elevated Split Squat
safeSubstitutions.rationale: Eliminates spinal axial compression while training leg drive.
Direct glute hypertrophy without forward lumbar spinal flexion.

rehabCues: Perform McGill Big 3 (Bird-Dog, Side Plank, Curl-up) prior to any training.
Maintain active brace with 360-degree intra-abdominal pressure.

name: Sacroiliac (SI) Joint Irritation
description: Localized pain over the posterior superior iliac spine (PSIS), aggravated by asymmetrical loading or split positions.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Bilateral loading stabilizes the pelvis and avoids SI shearing.
Bilateral landing eliminates asymmetrical pelvis rotational torque.

rehabCues: Isometric adductor squeeze and glute bridge activation prior to squats.

name: Wrist Strain / Front Rack Extension Pain
description: Pain on the dorsal or ulnar aspect of the wrist during heavy front rack receiving positions or wide snatch grips.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Maintains clean extension power without forcing the wrist into deep extension.
Zombie or cross-arm rack removes all wrist load while maintaining upright torso mechanics.

rehabCues: Warm up latissimus dorsi and thoracic spine to improve elbow height in the rack.

name: Proximal Hamstring Tendinopathy / Strain
description: Deep ache near the ischial tuberosity (sit bone) aggravated by deep hip flexion and loaded eccentrics.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Avoids loaded end-range hip flexion stretch.

rehabCues: Isometric single leg bridge holds (4x30s) before pulling sessions.

name: Femoroacetabular Impingement (FAI) / Hip Pinch
description: Anterior hip pinching at the bottom of a deep squat or snatch catch due to bone-on-bone abutment.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Higher catch avoids anterior hip pinch in full flexion.
Prevents going below parallel where impingement occurs.

rehabCues: Banded hip joint distraction, 90/90 hip mobility, and psoas release.

name: Achilles Tendinopathy
description: Morning stiffness and localized tendon pain 2-6cm above the calcaneus, provoked by explosive plyometric jumps and rebound catches.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Removes aggressive foot stomp and dynamic impact on the Achilles.

rehabCues: Heavy slow resistance (HSR) straight-leg and bent-knee calf raises.

name: Medial Epicondylalgia (Golfer's / Lifter's Elbow)
description: Inner elbow irritation at the common flexor tendon origin from heavy grip tension and aggressive snatch turnovers.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Neutral grip relieves medial elbow flexor tendon tension.

rehabCues: Wrist flexor eccentric Tyler twists with flexbar, forearm soft tissue release.

name: Cervical / Upper Trapezius Strain
description: Neck muscle spasm or facet joint tightness following heavy overhead catches or high shrug loads.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Floor provides back support and avoids cervical extension under load.

rehabCues: Gentle chin tucks, scalene breathing drills, and thoracic mobility.

name: Adductor / Groin Strain
description: Strain of adductor longus/magnus, aggravated by wide squat stances, sumo pulls, and split jerk recovery.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Narrow stance eliminates adductor stretch and torque.
Unilateral controlled tempo reduces adductor shear.
Catching above parallel with hip-width feet minimizes groin strain.

rehabCues: Perform Copenhagen adductor side planks (3x20s).
Gradually restore hip abduction tolerance with light Cossack squats.

name: 1st MTP Joint Sprain (Turf Toe / Jerk Foot)
description: Capsular sprain at the base of the great toe, aggravated by rear foot hyperextension during the Split Jerk catch.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Power jerk eliminates rear foot MTP joint extension.
Parallel foot receiving position protects the toe joint.

rehabCues: Use a stiff carbon plate in lifting shoe to restrict 1st MTP extension.
Perform isometric toe flexion gripping drills.

name: Biceps Long Head Tendinopathy
description: Inflammation in the bicipital groove of anterior shoulder, aggravated by arm-pulling in cleans and deep dips.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Straps keep arms relaxed and straight, avoiding bicipital tensile strain.
Eliminates clean catch impact while training overhead drive.

rehabCues: Perform isometric biceps curls at 90 degrees with neutral grip.
Ensure arms stay straight until full hip contact during pulls.

name: Hook Grip Thumb UCL Sprain
description: Ulnar collateral ligament microtrauma and joint capsule irritation at the base of the thumb from heavy barbell hook gripping.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Straps remove thumb compression while allowing full speed lifts.
Maintains triple extension pulling volume without hook grip shear.

rehabCues: Apply cohesive elastic tape around thumb IP joint for bar cushioning.
Perform contrast baths and gentle thumb extensor band work.

name: Latissimus Dorsi & Rhomboid Strain
description: Muscular strain along mid-back/lat insertion from holding dynamic spinal extension against heavy floor pulls.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: High hang position eliminates floor pull lat shear.
Blocks bypass floor lift initiation strain.
Posterior chain hypertrophy without high-tension isometric lat shear.

rehabCues: Perform thoracic foam roller extension drills and side-lying lat stretches.
Focus on sub-maximal tempo hang pulls before floor pulls.

name: Intercostal / Rib Cartilage Strain
description: Costal cartilage strain or chest wall bruising caused by bar crash impact on the clavicle/sternum in the clean receiving position.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Trains full extension without barbell rack impact.
Back rack bypasses anterior thoracic rib pressure.

rehabCues: Eliminate direct bar contact on chest during clean catch.
Focus on controlled diaphragmatic breathing.

name: Medial Tibial Stress Syndrome (Shin Splints)
description: Periostitis along tibia from repetitive plyometrics, jumping, or rapid foot displacement in lifting shoes.

safeSubstitutions.rationale: Eliminates foot stomp impact while training overhead power.
No-feet transition prevents tibia ground reaction shock.

rehabCues: Perform standing tibialis anterior raises against wall (3x25).
Gentle calf foam rolling and soft tissue work.
